title: Asset provenance (REQ-015)
description: The per-asset provenance.json sidecar. Every asset records who made it, how, and under what terms; an AI-generated asset additionally records the generator and the prompt. The conditional lives HERE, in the schema, rather than in validator code - a contributor reading this file and an agent generating assets both see the whole rule, and the validator merely evaluates it.

author.description: Who contributed this asset - a person or an agent identity, never empty.

generationMethod.description: The field the conditional below branches on.

licenseTerms.description: Applicable license terms. For ai-generated assets these are the generator's terms of service, which is why this field intersects the project licensing decision and may not be omitted.

tool.description: Generator name and version. Required for ai-generated assets; not required for hand-authored ones.

prompt.description: The prompt used. Required for ai-generated assets; not required for hand-authored ones.
